deleteOrg.title: Delete Organization
deleteOrg.body: This will permanently delete "{name}" and all its data. This action cannot be undone.

removeUser.title: Remove User
removeUser.body: Remove "{email}" from this organization? They will lose access to all resources.

deleteRole.title: Delete Role
deleteRole.body: Delete role "{name}"? Users with this role will lose its permissions.

deleteSystem.title: Delete System
deleteSystem.body: Delete system "{name}" and revoke all its tokens?

revokeToken.title: Revoke Token
revokeToken.body: Revoke this token? Any services using it will lose access immediately.

deleteWorkflow.title: Delete Workflow
deleteWorkflow.body: Delete workflow "{name}" and all its versions? Existing messages will not be affected.

deactivateVersion.title: Deactivate Version
deactivateVersion.body: Deactivate version {number}? New messages will not use this version.

tokenShowOnce.heading: Token Created
tokenShowOnce.body: Copy your private token now. It will not be shown again.
